# cb:b131

> The extraction-time discipline applies across all data layers: provenance attribution happens when reading source documents (b125), assertions are created when reading sources or reasoning about entities (b119), and event log entries are written at mutation time (a128). Retroactive attribution is prohibited at every layer because post-hoc source assignment is inherently unreliable.

**Type:** inference · **Kind:** design-rationale · **Domain:**  · **Status:** active
**Created:** 2026-03-23

## Depends on

- [cb:b119](b119.md) - Beliefs are created at extraction time - when the agent is actively reading a source or reasoning about entities - not backfilled retroactively.
- [cb:b125](b125.md) - Provenance _source attribution must only be assigned at extraction time - when the agent is actively reading the source document and pulling data from it.
